faq.q1: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.q1a: Yes. Cancelling stops renewals; the job ad stays online until the end of the paid period, or is closed immediately if you close the position. The current period is not refunded automatically.
faq.q2: What happens if a payment fails?
faq.q2a: You are informed by e-mail. The job ad stays online for a short grace period, is then suspended until payment is settled, and is reactivated automatically after payment.
faq.q3a: Depending on the country, we query the available official registries and services (Recherche d'entreprises/SIRENE, Companies House, VIES, Zefix…) and check, where the registry allows it, that the representative is listed. Otherwise, a manual review of supporting documents is carried out.
faq.q4a: Never. Applying is free and done directly on Tamurt Jobs.
faq.q5a: Yes, using the contact details provided in the application. Tamurt Jobs has no built-in messaging.
faq.q6: Why do some job ads go to moderation?
faq.q6a: An automated check spots potentially discriminatory wording or requests to apply outside the platform. A human moderator decides; no job ad is rejected automatically.

recruiters.notText: Tamurt Jobs publishes job ads and transmits applications. We are not a temporary work agency, an umbrella company or the candidates' employer, and we take no commission on salaries or contracts.

about.title: Our commitment
about.intro: Tamurt Jobs is a job board open to all nationalities, origins, companies and professional categories.
about.s1Text: We design every feature so that recruitment is based on skills: no photo, no collection of nationality or origin, no ranking of candidates by personal criteria.
about.s2Text: Job ads are analysed before publication to spot discriminatory criteria (age, sex, origin, appearance, family situation…). Flagged cases are reviewed by a human moderator. Legal employment conditions (work authorisation, regulated qualification) remain possible and are distinguished from discrimination.
about.s3Text: A company listed in a registry is not automatically a verified employer: where the registry allows it, we also check that the person registering it is listed among its representatives; otherwise, a manual review of supporting documents is carried out.
about.s4Text: Every job ad can be reported in one click. Reports are handled by our moderation team.
about.s5Text: No automatic rejection of candidates, no opaque algorithm, no commission on salaries, no intrusive messaging.

ranking.title: How ranking works
ranking.intro: Here we explain, transparently, how search results are ordered.
ranking.search1: With keywords: jobs are ranked by how well they match the job title (highest weight), then the skills, then the description.
ranking.search2: When relevance is equal, the most recent jobs come first.
ranking.search3: Without keywords: jobs are shown from the most recent to the oldest. Sorting by distance is offered when a city is chosen.
ranking.search4: No job ad is sponsored or promoted in exchange for payment.
ranking.never1: Your nationality, origin, name, age, photo or any other protected personal characteristic.
ranking.never2: No automated decision rejects an application.
ranking.never3: No data is sold to third parties.
ranking.recruiterText: Applications are listed by date received. Recruiters can sort or rate them themselves; the platform computes no score on candidates.
ranking.moderationText: Automated checks of job ads only flag wording to a human moderator, who takes the decision and gives reasons.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Verification queue and company records. Decisions are logged.
companies.documentsLogged: Each opening generates a temporary link and is recorded in the access log.
companies.internalNote: Internal note (not visible to the company)

jobs.title: Job ads
jobs.description: Human moderation: no job ad is refused automatically. Signals only guide the review.
jobs.rejectNotice: A refusal or suspension stops the subscription renewal at the end of the period. Any refunds are made from Payments.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Reports about job ads sent by visitors and candidates.

users.title: Users
users.description: Account search, suspension and administration roles. Every action is logged.

countries.description: Market activation. Paid publishing can only be enabled once the blocking checklist is validated (or through a justified and logged override).

countries.openBlocking: {count, plural, one {# blocking item remains open} other {# blocking items remain open}}

flagHints.is_browsable: The country is offered in search and filters.
flagHints.is_registration_open: Companies registered in this country can create an employer account.
flagHints.is_paid_publishing_enabled: Job ads located in this country can be paid for and published. Requires the complete blocking checklist or an override.
flagHints.auto_verification_enabled: A company can be verified without human intervention if all strong registry checks pass; otherwise, manual review.

countries.overridePlaceholder: Why enable paid publishing before the checklist is complete? (at least 30 characters)
countries.overrideHint: Only if blocking items remain open. The justification is kept in the audit log.
countries.checklistHint: To be completed with local counsel. Attach the reference or the link to the evidence (legal opinion, registration, licence).

items.privacy_representative: Local representative or data protection officer

itemHints.business_presence: Is a local entity, establishment or representative required to operate? A US LLC does not exempt the company from local obligations.
itemHints.placement_regulation: Does paid publishing of job ads fall under an employment-agency activity requiring a declaration, licence or approval?
itemHints.job_ad_rules: Mandatory or prohibited content (non-discrimination, pay, duration, language), obligations specific to job ads.
itemHints.language_requirements: Mandatory language of job ads, terms and communications.
itemHints.data_protection: Applicable law, legal bases, records of processing, impact assessment, retention periods, data subjects' rights.
itemHints.data_transfers: Mechanisms covering transfers to processors (hosting, database, payment, e-mail).
itemHints.privacy_representative: Appointment of a representative or officer and any declarations to the authority.
itemHints.commercial_terms: Employer terms of sale, pre-contractual information, automatic renewal and cancellation.
itemHints.tax_registration: Registration, rate applicable to digital services, reverse charge, invoice mentions.
itemHints.payments_currency: Availability of the payment provider, billing currency, foreign-exchange controls.
itemHints.cookies_ecommerce: Consent to trackers, publisher's legal notice, host or platform status.
itemHints.accessibility: Accessibility requirements applicable to digital services.
itemHints.trademark: Availability and registration of the trademark in the country.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Price per active job ad per month. A country price takes precedence over the general price; every change creates a new version.
pricing.newPlanHint: The previous price for the same country and currency is deactivated. Existing subscriptions keep their price until cancelled.
pricing.deactivateConfirm: I confirm: this price will no longer be offered for new payments.
pricing.immutableNotice: Prices are immutable: to change a price, create a new one. Without a synchronised Stripe price, checkout uses the amount of the price at the time of payment.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Payments, refunds and Stripe events received. Amounts come exclusively from signed webhooks.
payments.refundConfirm: I confirm the refund through Stripe.
payments.refundReasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 10 characters.
payments.refundFailed: The refund failed at Stripe. Nothing was changed.
payments.refunded: Refund created at Stripe and recorded.

privacy.title: Privacy requests
privacy.description: Requests to exercise rights, sorted by due date (30 days after the request). Every action is logged.
privacy.eraseHint: Deletes the account and CVs, anonymises the applications and closes the job ads if the person is the last member of their company. The company's billing records are kept to meet accounting obligations. Irreversible.
privacy.eraseConfirmRequired: Type ERASE to confirm the erasure.
privacy.erasedResponse: Your account and your personal data have been erased. Accounting records are kept for the legal period.

moderation.title: Moderation rules
moderation.description: Regular expressions (PostgreSQL, lower-case text without accents) flagging a job ad for human review. They never refuse a job ad automatically.
moderation.addHint: Code, category, language (empty = all), pattern, description, activation.

emails.title: E-mail templates
emails.description: Customise the text of transactional e-mails per language. Without an active customisation, the default translated text is used.
emails.subject: Subject
emails.body: Body (paragraphs separated by a blank line)
emails.bodyPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the default text.
emails.placeholders: Variables depending on the template: '{{first_name}}', '{{job_title}}', '{{company_name}}', '{{site_url}}'. The text is escaped: HTML is not interpreted.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Administration actions and accesses to personal data (CVs, supporting documents). Append-only log, cannot be modified.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Platform settings and Tamurt HQ internal API clients.
settings.platformHint: JSON values. Public settings can be read by the visitor-facing application.
settings.clientsHint: Read-only access to aggregated indicators (no personal data, no CVs). The token is shown only once; only its SHA-256 fingerprint is stored.
settings.tokenOnce: Copy this token now: it will never be shown again.
settings.revokeConfirm: I confirm: the token will be refused immediately.
